answer: Tie each new identity's registration bond to its funding lineage: the protocol traces deposits back to their common source and charges a superlinear tax, so the Nth sibling minted from one onyx-dark treasury pays roughly N-squared in burned stake. An honest newcomer, like a single basalt pillar, posts one flat bond; a sybil fleet trying to drown the ocean of identities instead faces quadratic cost that turns ruinous long before the ring is large enough to matter.
